scope: Independent saved-array audit; no nonlinear optimization or physical adequacy certification. Failure-pair diagnostic fits are included in stationarity checks only; no local uncertainty manufactured for them.
stationarity_definition: For cost 0.5*r.T*r, g=J.T*r, max(abs(g)*distance_to_bound_in_descent_direction) equals finite-bound Coleman-Li SciPy TRF optimality.
local_uncertainty_definition: All other normalized nuisance columns projected out of the weighted 2382 displacement column. Nuisance-profiled local linear sigma conditional on architecture and diagonal errors; bounds and systematics ignored.

optimization_caveats.interpretation: Historical selected-basin pair did not outperform a lower feasible conventional endpoint. Quadrature differs; exact same-quadrature comparison requires replay. Check canonical recovery before use.

warnings: Successful ftol termination does not imply gtol convergence or a global optimum.
